name: Piricse (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with narrow stripes of blue and red along each side edge, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Piricse (a red and yellow shield with an iris) below a scroll inscribed 1299 PIRICSE.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
